working_title: The €200 Billion Branch: How Danske Bank Laundered Europe
one_line_hook: A sleepy Estonian branch moved €200bn of suspicious money while Copenhagen looked the other way — and a whistleblower paid the price.
notes: Bruun & Hjejle report, DOJ/SEC 2022 settlement ($2bn), Howard Wilkinson testimony, Berlingske/DR archives. Flagship episode candidate.

working_title: Bigger Than Denmark: The Novo Nordisk Ozempic Boom and Wobble
one_line_hook: A century-old insulin maker became Europe's most valuable company, distorted Denmark's GDP, then lost half its value in a year.
notes: Ongoing story (CEO ousted May 2025, guidance cuts, layoffs); frame as rise + first stumble. Novo Nordisk Foundation structure is a great angle. DK sources: Børsen, Berlingske.

working_title: Spotify: How a Swedish Pirate-Killer Took Over the World's Ears
one_line_hook: Built to beat The Pirate Bay, Spotify never made an annual profit until 2024 — and still reshaped an entire industry.
notes: Ek/Lorentzon; label licensing deals; podcast bet (Rogan) and unwind; first full-year profit 2024. Book: The Spotify Play (Carlsson/Leijonhufvud).

working_title: Ericsson's Iraq Problem: Bribes, ISIS Checkpoints and a $1bn Fine
one_line_hook: An internal report leaked to ICIJ suggested Ericsson money may have reached Islamic State — years after it already paid $1bn to the DOJ.
notes: 2019 DOJ DPA ($1.06bn), 2022 Ericsson List (ICIJ), 2023 DPA breach plea. Also fold in 2001 Cell Phone Wars context briefly.

working_title: Telia and the Dictator's Daughter: A $965 Million Bribery Case
one_line_hook: Sweden's state-backed telecom paid hundreds of millions to Gulnara Karimova to enter Uzbekistan — and its executives walked free.
notes: SVT Uppdrag granskning broke it; DOJ/SEC/Dutch settlement 2017; Swedish acquittals 2019/2021. OCCRP archive rich.

working_title: Steinhoff: The €10 Billion Hole in Europe's Furniture Giant
one_line_hook: Poundland, Conforama, Mattress Firm — all owned by a Frankfurt-listed group whose accounts were fiction.
notes: PwC report 2019, Markus Jooste death 2024. European angle via Frankfurt listing and Conforama/Poundland. Wirecard-adjacent audience.

working_title: Lego 2004: How the Brick Nearly Broke
one_line_hook: Star Wars, theme parks and 12,000 SKUs took Lego to the edge of bankruptcy — a 35-year-old ex-McKinsey consultant saved it.
notes: Books: Brick by Brick (Robertson), The Lego Story (Andersen). Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen/Knudstorp. Extremely evergreen.

working_title: Ingvar Kamprad: The Flat-Pack Billionaire Who Hid Everything
one_line_hook: Ikea's founder built the world's largest furniture chain, a secret Liechtenstein foundation structure and a Nazi past he tried to forget.
notes: Interogo/Stichting INGKA structure (SVT Uppdrag granskning 2011), Elisabeth Åsbrink's book on Nazi ties. Careful legal framing.

working_title: Klarna: The $46 Billion Bank That Became a $6 Billion Bank
one_line_hook: Sweden's fintech darling lost 85% of its value in a year, fired staff via video, then IPO'd in New York anyway.
notes: Sebastian Siemiatkowski profile; 2022 down round; AI-replaces-staff claims; Sept 2025 NYSE IPO. Breakit/DI for Swedish sources.

working_title: Signa: How René Benko's €23bn Property Empire Vanished
one_line_hook: Austria's youngest billionaire owned Selfridges and the Chrysler Building — until Europe's biggest property collapse and a jail cell.
notes: Insolvency 2023, convicted 2025 (further trials pending) — check latest status at production. Der Standard, Handelsblatt, FT deep dives.

working_title: Volvo Cars: Sold to China for Less Than Ford Paid for a Logo
one_line_hook: Ford bought Volvo for $6.5bn, sold it to a Chinese upstart for $1.8bn — and Geely turned it into a bigger success.
notes: Li Shufu, Håkan Samuelsson, Polestar SPAC flop, 2021 IPO. Add EU tariff dimension. DI/GP archives.

working_title: Rovio: Angry Birds and the Curse of the One-Hit Wonder
one_line_hook: Fifty-one failed games, one global phenomenon, a theme park, a movie — then a sale to Sega for a fraction of the hype.
notes: Peter Vesterbacka era, 2017 IPO, Sega acquisition 2023 (€706m). Fun contrast with Supercell ep.

working_title: Equinor: How Norway Turned Oil Into a $2 Trillion Fund (and Kept Drilling)
one_line_hook: Statoil, the oil fund, the rebrand to Equinor — and the awkward question of a green nation's fossil fortune.
notes: US shale losses ($21bn write-down, DN investigation 2020), rebrand 2018, oil fund governance. Strong evergreen explainer.

working_title: Swedbank: The Other Baltic Laundromat
one_line_hook: After Danske, SVT proved Swedbank had moved billions of suspect Baltic money — the CEO was sacked, convicted, then cleared by the Supreme Court.
notes: Natural sequel to Danske ep. Clifford Chance report 2020, SEK 4bn FI fine, Bonnesen convicted 2024 (appeal), acquitted by Supreme Court 2026 — verify final status.

working_title: Ørsted: From Oil Giant to Green Champion to Rights Issue
one_line_hook: DONG Energy reinvented itself as the world's offshore-wind leader — then US politics and inflation forced a DKK 60bn emergency raise.
notes: Two-act structure: 2008-2020 transformation, 2023-25 write-downs & Trump stop-work orders. Ongoing; verify latest.

working_title: Fortum and Uniper: How Finland Bought a German Gas Bomb
one_line_hook: Finland's state utility spent €7bn buying a company built on Russian gas — then handed it to Germany for €500m.
notes: IEEFA post-mortem, HS/YLE archives, Bundestag debates. Great 'predictable and avoidable' angle.

working_title: Supercell: The Finnish Studio That Kills Its Own Games
one_line_hook: Fewer than 500 people, four hits and $10bn from Tencent — built on a culture of celebrating cancelled games with champagne.
notes: Ilkka Paananen interviews, Tencent 2016 deal, tax angle (Finland's biggest taxpayers), Clash of Clans/Brawl Stars data. HS/Talouselämä.

working_title: H&M: How Fast Fashion's Pioneer Lost the Plot
one_line_hook: The Persson family built the world's second-largest fashion retailer — then Shein, Zara and Xinjiang cotton caught up.
notes: Burning unsold clothes (2017), China boycott 2021, CEO churn, 2024 leadership change. DI, Breakit.

working_title: Saab: How a Small Country Builds Its Own Fighter Jet
one_line_hook: Sweden lost its car brand but kept its arms maker — Gripen, submarines and a defence boom after NATO accession.
notes: Include Saab Automobile bankruptcy 2011 (GM/Spyker/NEVS) as prologue. Wallenberg ownership. Fits 2025-26 defence-spend zeitgeist.

working_title: Norwegian Air: The Low-Cost Airline That Tried to Fly Across the Atlantic
one_line_hook: Bjørn Kjos bet a small Nordic carrier on 787s and long-haul — Boeing groundings and Covid nearly killed it.
notes: Dreamliner engine issues, IAG bid 2018, 2020-21 restructuring, long-haul exit. DN/E24 sources.

working_title: SAS: Scandinavia's Flag Carrier and Its Chapter 11
one_line_hook: Three governments, one airline, decades of losses and a New York bankruptcy that ended with Air France-KLM in charge.
notes: 2022 pilot strike triggered Chapter 11; Sweden exit as owner; 2024 emergence. Compare with Norwegian ep.

working_title: Nokian Tyres: The Finnish Company That Was 80% Russian
one_line_hook: Its most profitable factory was near St Petersburg — when Russia invaded Ukraine, Nokian had to sell it for €400m and start over.
notes: Tatneft sale 2023, Romania greenfield plant, 116m loss; broader 'Finnish firms in Russia' angle. HS/Kauppalehti.

working_title: Vestas: The Danish Company That Invented the Wind Industry
one_line_hook: From blacksmiths in Jutland to the world's largest turbine maker — via a near-death crisis in 2012 and brutal Chinese competition.
notes: Ditlev Engel era, 2012 restructuring, Anders Runevad turnaround; Chinese price war 2023-25. Pair with Ørsted.

working_title: Nordea: The Nordic Bank Named in the Panama Papers
one_line_hook: The region's largest bank helped clients set up offshore shells — Denmark's prosecutors want a record DKK 6bn.
notes: NYDFS $35m 2024; Danish criminal case ongoing (verify). Also HQ move Stockholm-Helsinki over resolution fees. Pair with Danske/Swedbank as trilogy.

working_title: Wolt: The €7 Billion Helsinki Delivery App
one_line_hook: Five years from a Helsinki coffee-ordering app to DoorDash's biggest ever acquisition — and the courier-employment fights that followed.
notes: Miki Kuusi, 2021 €7bn deal, EU platform-work directive; Kuusi now runs DoorDash international + Deliveroo. Talouselämä/HS.

working_title: Finnair: The Airline That Lost Its Shortcut
one_line_hook: Built on being Europe's fastest route to Asia via Russian airspace, Finnair lost its business model overnight in February 2022.
notes: Airspace closure impact, 2023 rights issue, Qatar wet-lease, pivot to India/Doha; earlier Aurinkomatkat/strike issues. Pair with SAS/Norwegian.

working_title: Oatly: The Oat-Milk IPO That Curdled
one_line_hook: A Swedish oat drink became a $10bn Nasdaq stock, was attacked by a short seller, and lost 95% of its value.
notes: Toni Petersson, Blackstone stake backlash, Spruce Point 2021, Chinese factory write-offs, ongoing survival. DI/Breakit.

working_title: Kone: The Finnish Family That Owns the World's Lifts
one_line_hook: Antti Herlin's family firm quietly became one of the world's most profitable industrial companies — with China as its biggest bet.
notes: Herlin family, Pekka Herlin biography (Uusi kirja), Thyssenkrupp Elevator bid 2020, China property downturn. Lower search demand; strong for core audience.

working_title: Neste: The Oil Refiner That Bet Everything on Used Cooking Oil
one_line_hook: Finland's state refiner became the world's renewable-diesel leader — then the market it created turned on it.
notes: 2024-25 profit collapse, share fall ~70%, CEO change, US layoffs; palm-oil controversy. HS/Kauppalehti.

working_title: Wärtsilä: Ships, Engines and a Rescue Wrapped in Nuclear Ambition
one_line_hook: A 190-year-old Finnish engine maker keeps reinventing itself — now betting on methanol ships and grid batteries.
notes: Includes 1989 Wärtsilä Marine bankruptcy (Finland's biggest at the time), Russia exit 2022, energy storage pivot. Niche; pair with Kone.
